## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Text
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Fonts and font selection
//  - Shaped glyphs and text on a path
//  - Text styling and layout

//==
// # Fonts and font selection
//
// The axes a concrete font face is chosen on — weight, slant, and width — the
// face request that names them, the vertical metrics a face reports, and the
// OpenType feature settings applied on top. Run and paragraph styling, and
// shaped glyph results, follow in the sections below.

// A font weight on the CSS 100-900 scale: 100=Thin, 300=Light, 400=Normal,
// 500=Medium, 700=Bold, 900=Black. Intermediate values are valid for
// variable fonts. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Font)
type FontWeight
    implements IValue, IComparable
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// The slant style of a font face: upright, a designed italic face, or a
// slanted version of the normal face.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italic_type)
type FontStyle = Normal | Italic | Oblique;

// The width class of a font face, on the CSS nine-step scale.
type FontStretch
    = UltraCondensed
    | ExtraCondensed
    | Condensed
    | SemiCondensed
    | Normal
    | SemiExpanded
    | Expanded
    | ExtraExpanded
    | UltraExpanded;

// A request for a concrete font: a family name plus the weight, slant, and
// width axes used to select (or synthesize) a face.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Typeface)
type FontFace
    implements IValue
{
    Family: String;
    Weight: FontWeight;
    Style: FontStyle;
    Stretch: FontStretch;
}

// Vertical metrics of a face, expressed at a font size of one (multiply by
// the em size in use). Descent and UnderlinePosition are positive downward
// from the baseline.
type FontMetrics
    implements IValue
{
    Ascent: Number;
    Descent: Number;
    LineGap: Number;
    CapHeight: Number;
    XHeight: Number;
    UnderlinePosition: Number;
    UnderlineThickness: Number;
}

// One OpenType feature setting, such as ("liga", 1) to enable ligatures or
// ("ss01", 1) to select a stylistic set. Tag is the four-character feature
// tag; IValue is 0=off, 1=on, or an alternate index for selector features.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OpenType)
type OpenTypeFeature
    implements IValue
{
    Tag: String;
    Value: Integer;
}

//==
// # Shaped glyphs and text on a path
//
// The output side of text: the positioned glyphs shaping produces, the glyph
// run that groups them, the glyph converted to vector geometry, and a run laid
// along a path. This is the bridge from text to the outlines of
// `paths.types.plato`.

// One positioned glyph produced by shaping: the font-internal glyph
// identifier, the placement origin relative to the run origin, and the
// advance to the next glyph (x and y, supporting vertical scripts).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Glyph)
type GlyphPlacement
    implements IValue
{
    GlyphId: Integer;
    Position: Point2D;
    Advance: Vector2D;
}

// The output of shaping one run with one face at one size: a sequence of
// positioned glyphs ready for rasterization or outlining.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Text_shaping)
type GlyphRun
    implements IValue
{
    Font: FontFace;
    Size: Number;
    Placements: Array<GlyphPlacement>;
}

// A glyph converted to vector geometry: its outline as a path (already
// scaled to the em size in use) and its advance.
type GlyphOutline
    implements IValue
{
    GlyphId: Integer;
    Path: Path2D;
    Advance: Vector2D;
}

// A run of text laid along a path: glyph baselines follow the path's
// tangent. StartOffset is the arc length from the path start to the first
// glyph; Spacing is added between glyphs, in the same units.
type TextOnPath
    implements IValue
{
    Run: TextRun;
    Path: Path2D;
    StartOffset: Number;
    Spacing: Number;
}

//==
// # Text styling and layout
//
// Character-level run styling, paragraph settings, and the layout input that
// pairs a sequence of styled runs with its wrapping constraints. Font
// selection is the first section above; the shaped glyph output of laying this
// out is the section before this one.

// A line decoration drawn with a run of text.
type TextDecoration = None | Underline | Overline | StrikeThrough;

// Character-level styling for a run of text. Size is the em size in document
// units. LetterSpacing and WordSpacing are additive adjustments in the same
// units. LineHeight is a multiple of Size (1.0 is tight).
type TextStyle
    implements IValue
{
    Font: FontFace;
    Size: Number;
    LetterSpacing: Number;
    WordSpacing: Number;
    LineHeight: Number;
    Color: Color;
    Decoration: TextDecoration;
}
```
